description: This file defines an abstract class SuiteCRM\Search\SearchEngine that provides the interface and utility methods for search engine implementations within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for performing searches, displaying forms and results, and validating queries, as well as namespace and external class references.

classes.name: SearchEngine
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface and utility functions for search engine implementations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a search using the search engine with a given SearchQuery, returning SearchResults.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and displays the search form and results if any.

methods.name: displayForm
methods.description: Displays the search form using SearchFormController.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the SearchQuery; trims whitespace by default, throws exception if invalid.
